identificationModule.briefTitle: Once-Weekly GLP-1 Therapy for Adults With Poorly Controlled Type 2 Diabetes

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Tests whether a once-weekly injectable lowers HbA1c more than standard care in adults whose diabetes is not controlled on metformin.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes for at least 6 months
* HbA1c between 7.5% and 10.5% at screening
* Currently taking metformin at a stable dose for 3 months
* BMI of 25 kg/m2 or higher

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes
* eGFR less than 30 mL/min/1.73m2
* History of pancreatitis
* Currently pregnant or breastfeeding
* Use of insulin within the last 90 days
* Any condition that, in the investigator's opinion, makes participation unsafe

identificationModule.briefTitle: Digital Coaching Plus SGLT2 Inhibitor in Type 2 Diabetes With Kidney Disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Evaluates an app-based coaching program added to an SGLT2 inhibitor for people with diabetes and reduced kidney function.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 40 to 80 years
* Type 2 diabetes mellitus
* eGFR between 25 and 60 mL/min/1.73m2
* Owns a smartphone

Exclusion Criteria:

* Dialysis or kidney transplant
* HbA1c greater than 11%
* Heart failure hospitalization in the past 3 months

identificationModule.briefTitle: Intensive Insulin Titration for Type 2 Diabetes in Older Adults

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Compares two insulin titration schedules in adults 65 and older.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 65 years or older
* Type 2 diabetes treated with insulin
* HbA1c of at least 8%

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe hypoglycemia in the past 6 months
* Active malignancy

identificationModule.briefTitle: Blood Pressure Self-Monitoring With Pharmacist Support

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Tests home blood pressure monitoring with telehealth pharmacist visits for uncontrolled hypertension.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of hypertension
* Systolic blood pressure of 140 mmHg or higher at screening
* Age 30 to 85

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Chronic kidney disease requiring dialysis
* Heart attack or stroke within the past 6 months

identificationModule.briefTitle: Remote Monitoring for Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Evaluates a wearable sensor that alerts care teams to early signs of fluid buildup.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Heart failure with left ventricular ejection fraction of 40% or less
* Hospitalized for heart failure in the past 12 months
* Age 18 years or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* eGFR below 20 mL/min/1.73m2
* Life expectancy under 1 year due to non-cardiac disease

identificationModule.briefTitle: Extended-Release Buprenorphine After Emergency Department Visit

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Starts monthly buprenorphine injections in the emergency department and links patients to ongoing treatment.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Meets DSM-5 criteria for opioid use disorder
* Age 18 to 65 years
* Willing to start buprenorphine treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently receiving methadone treatment
* Pregnant or breastfeeding
* Severe liver disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Studies two doses of psilocybin with psychological support in adults whose depression has not responded to treatment.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of major depressive disorder
* Age 21 to 65 years
* Failed at least two antidepressant treatments

Exclusion Criteria:

* Bipolar disorder or schizophrenia
* Systolic blood pressure above 150 mmHg
* Pregnant or nursing

identificationModule.briefTitle: Oral SERD Versus Standard Endocrine Therapy in ER+ Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Compares a new oral pill with standard endocrine therapy after progression on first-line treatment.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Postmenopausal women
* Diagnosis of ER-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer
* ECOG performance status 0-1

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior chemotherapy for advanced disease
* Untreated brain metastases

identificationModule.briefTitle: Biologic Therapy for Severe Eosinophilic Asthma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Tests an injectable biologic in people with severe asthma who still have attacks despite inhalers.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of asthma for at least 12 months
* Age 12 to 75 years
* Two or more asthma attacks needing oral steroids in the past year

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current smoker or more than 10 pack-years
* Diagnosis of COPD
* Pregnancy

identificationModule.briefTitle: Weekly Injectable for Weight Management in Adults With Obesity

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Measures weight loss with a weekly injection plus lifestyle counseling over 68 weeks.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI of 30 kg/m2 or greater
* Age 18 to 70 years
* At least one failed dieting attempt

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes
* HbA1c of 10% or higher
* History of pancreatitis
* Currently taking a GLP-1 receptor agonist

identificationModule.briefTitle: Finerenone for Chronic Kidney Disease Without Diabetes

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Tests whether finerenone slows kidney function decline in non-diabetic kidney disease.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic kidney disease
* eGFR between 25 and 90 mL/min/1.73m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes or type 2 diabetes
* Dialysis

identificationModule.briefTitle: Smartphone Relapse Prevention for Alcohol Use Disorder

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Evaluates an app that combines craving tracking with coaching messages after treatment.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Alcohol use disorder
* Age 18 years or older
* Completed a treatment program in the past 30 days

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently taking naltrexone
* Schizophrenia
